entries.title: Page SEO panel.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Open a seeded Page edit screen and capture the SEO tab/panel added by SEO Suite.
entries.useCase: An editor edits page-level metadata, canonical state, social metadata, and SEO checks.

entries.title: SEO audit page.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Seed at least one page_seo_snapshots row so score, severity, and status columns are visible.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews SEO audit scores and remediation state for seeded pages.

entries.title: Search Console insights panel.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Seed search_console_url_metrics so dashboard widgets show clicks, impressions, movement, and opportunities.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews Search Console-style performance panels when metrics are seeded.

entries.title: Broken links page.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Seed a broken_links row connected to a page so the source page, target URL, status, and redirect action are visible.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews broken link findings and their source pages.

entries.title: AI Creator action modal.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Open a seeded Page edit screen and capture the SEO Suite AI Creator action modal with safe fixture content.
entries.useCase: An editor reviews AI-assisted metadata creation before accepting generated copy.

entries.title: Sitemap page.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Seed sitemap state through Site Discovery/SEO Suite integration so sitemap rows and status are visible.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews sitemap coverage and crawler-ready URL state.

entries.title: Translation coverage page.
entries.notes: Committed Capell runner capture promoted in marketplace media. Seed at least one site/page/language combination so translation coverage rows are visible.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews missing or stale translation coverage for SEO-relevant content.

entries.title: Not-found URLs page.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Requires capell-app/insights installed/migrated in the screenshot runner and a seeded missing page-view event before this can be captured.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews missing frontend URLs grouped by visitor count and latest view.

entries.title: AI Discovery page.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Seed AI Discovery site and page profiles so inclusion, summary, readiness, and Markdown columns are visible before capture.
entries.useCase: An administrator manages which public pages appear in AI-readable discovery output.

entries.title: SEO Suite settings page.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Capture the extension settings page after running capell:seo-suite-install so settings rows exist.
entries.useCase: An administrator reviews SEO audit, AI Discovery, crawler, Search Console, and AI provider settings.

entries.title: llms.txt output.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Seed AI Discovery site/page profiles and capture visitor-safe public text output through a runner scenario that can render plain text responses.
entries.useCase: An AI crawler reads the concise public page index for the site.

entries.title: robots.txt output.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Seed crawler rules or settings and capture public crawler directives through a runner scenario that can render plain text responses.
entries.useCase: A crawler or operator reviews the public robot directives generated by SEO Suite.

entries.title: Page Markdown output.
entries.notes: Optional follow-up. Enable Markdown pages on the AI Discovery site profile and capture visitor-safe Markdown through a runner scenario that can render plain text responses.
entries.useCase: An AI crawler reads the Markdown representation of a public page.
